Sub: Update on conversion of partly paid -up equity shares into fully paid -up equity shares, 
upon receipt of First and Final Call pursuant to Reminder Notice issued by the Company 
 
Dear Sir/ Ma’am, 
 
This is in furtherance to our earlier announcement dt. July 24, 2026 regarding approval of Special 
Committee of Directors for conversion of 460,833 partly paid-up equity shares of face value of INR 5 
each (paid-up value of INR 1.25 per share) into fully paid-up equity shares of face value of INR 5 each, 
upon receipt of First and Final Call pursuant to the Reminder Notice dt. July 1, 2026 issued by the 
Company. 
 
We wish to inform you that the Company has completed the necessary corporate actions for credit of 
460,340 fully paid-up equity shares to the demat accounts of eligible shareholders. The Company has 
also received listing and trading approvals from National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE 
Limited (collectively referred to as ‘Stock Exchanges’). Accordingly, the aforesaid 460,340 fully paid -
up equity shares shall be available for trading on the Stock Exchanges with effect from Wednesday, 
August 19, 2026, under existing fully paid-up ISIN INE397D01024. 
 
Please note that the corporate actions in respect of 493 partly paid -up equity shares could not be 
completed at the Depositories’ end on account of technical errors in the demat accounts of the 
concerned shareholders. The Company will take appropriate steps to convert such shares to fully paid-
up equity shares in due course, upon request from such shareholders. 
 
Kindly take the above information on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Sincerely yours, 
 
For Bharti Airtel Limited 
 
 
 
Rohit Krishan Puri 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
